evidence.summary: A 14-page original diagram-first prototype and production blueprint passed beginner, visual, cram, crosswalk, accuracy, print, Kindle, differentiation, rights, economics, and autonomous-QA gates.

details.product_thesis: A visual concept-and-misconception map for nontechnical first-time Technician candidates, paired with free randomized practice and a complete 409-question-ID diagnostic crosswalk.
details.primary_promise: See the reusable patterns behind the 2026-2030 Technician pool, recognize which pattern a question tests, and route every official ID to the supporting concept.

prototype.cluster: Ohm's law, series/parallel circuits, and meter placement

page_count.reason: Large-format diagram readability, 409-ID traceability, adequate navigation and review space, and viable large-trim black-ink economics.

details.production_autonomy: Codex owns source freeze, extraction, concept graph, draft, diagrams, crosswalk, claim ledger, independent factual audit, layout, Kindle conversion, preflight, and packaging research.

economics.precision_note: Planning estimates, not forecasts; final KDP calculator refresh required.

source_and_rights.pool: NCVEC February 19, 2026 release plus later official errata/withdrawals
source_and_rights.fcc: Current eCFR Title 47 Part 97 and official FCC/OET sources
source_and_rights.third_party_boundary: ARRL and competitor pedagogy, prose, diagrams, layouts, and mnemonics are market evidence only and must not be copied.

checks: official and mapped ID set equality
no missing, extra, or duplicate primary mappings
source URL, retrieval time, version, hash, and validity dates

kill_criteria: equivalent diagram-first complete-crosswalk competitor with meaningful traction
full scope degrades into sequential question-bank paraphrase
official pool cannot reconcile to 409 unique active IDs
unresolved critical or high technical, rule, safety, key, or rights claim
essential visual cannot be independently created or survive grayscale and Kindle
useful layout exceeds 240 pages or needs price above USD 19.99
material source drift shortens shelf life or invalidates mapping
Anton subject or structural dependency exceeds two hours

decisions.reason: The paid visual/crosswalk layer is distinct from free practice and sequential guides; the representative prototype passes all experience gates; authoritative sourcing, public-domain pool rights, deterministic 409-ID QA, print economics, and low Anton involvement are feasible.
